notes.title: 🎉 Demo Officially Live | New Areas, More Jenin, and Save Data Transfer!
notes.content:
[p]Greetings, brave adventurers![/p][p][/p][p]A massive thank you for all your incredible support and valuable feedback! After a series of careful adjustments and optimizations, we're thrilled to announce that the Demo for [i]Fantasy Idle Dungeon[/i] is officially live! An unknown journey awaits, filled with even more Jenin eager to join your ranks. Let's dive into all the exciting changes awaiting you in Jenin Town![/p][p][/p][p](Demo version supports save data transfer from Playtest.)[/p][p][/p][h3]The Demo version includes the following content:[/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]✨ [b]Expanded Exploration Areas:[/b] New maps unlocked, featuring [b]brand-new stages[/b], waiting for your challenge![/p][/*][*][p]👾 [b]Jenin Assemble:[/b] [b]New Jenins[/b] are making their debut! Go collect your companions and build your exclusive team![/p][/*][*][p]🏯 [b]Infinity Tower Breakthrough:[/b] The limit has been increased to [b]300 floors[/b]. Ascend to greater heights and push your limits![/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]More Optimizations and Adjustments[/h2][p][/p][list][*][p]Added a new equipment passive[/p][/*][*][p]Added 2 new talents[/p][/*][*][p]Gems of the same level and type now stack together[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where clicking "Dispatch" in the Hunting Lodge was ineffective[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where clicking to select Jenin for consumption during Jenin evolution was ineffective[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h2]❤️ Add to Wishlist and start your dungeon adventure![/h2][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3424610/_/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Your feedback is incredibly important to us and truly drives our progress. Encountered a bug or have suggestions on gameplay, Jenin development, or combat experience? Please don't hesitate to share! We're always eager to hear your thoughts and ideas.

Join our official Discord Channel: [url="https://discord.gg/sqGb8ey6DZ"]https://discord.gg/sqGb8ey6DZ[/url], to connect with fellow adventurers and share tips on raising your Jenin companions![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Playtest Version 1.0.18 Update
notes.content: [h2]New Features[/h2][list][*][p]The arena has added a leaderboard (it will only be listed after the update when challenging the Infinity Tower).[/p][/*][*][p]Press ctrl+ 'to bring up the console. Enter: ‘cleartower’ to reset the number of floors in the Infinity Tower[/p][/*][/list][h2]Adjustment[/h2][list][*][p]The Gem Bag in the Backpack can be used all at once by holding ctrl and then right-clicking[/p][/*][*][p]Meow Meow Rabbit's ability has been changed to a new ability: Purification[/p][/*][/list][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where AFK battles would cause memory leaks.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where completing non-main quest adventure maps would incorrectly complete main story Hell quests.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Playtest Version 1.0.16 Update
notes.content:
[h2]New Features[/h2][list][*][p] Added 10x Draw option to the Jenin Merchant’s Random Eggs [/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a refinement effect bug: The effect was incorrectly preventing damage every round, instead of only the first round of battle as intended.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some refinement effects were not triggering.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed instances where combat would occasionally freeze.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the Jenin list in the Jenin Lodge would not refresh after refining Jenin.
[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: v1.0.15 Playtest Update
notes.content:
[h2]New[/h2][list][*][p] Added Encyclopedia pages for BUFFs and Equipment Refinement.
[/p][/*][*][p] Added equipment lock function to prevent dismantling and selling.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p] Added Jenin talent lock function: Using Talent Scrolls will not replace locked talents, and each evolution grants 1 lock slot.
[/p][/*][/list][h2]Optimization/Adjustments[/h2][list][*][p] High-quality limited-time quests now grant extra rewards (Refinement Potions, Parchments, Potential Fruits).
[/p][/*][*][p] Disabled battle reward pop-up notifications.
[/p][/*][*][p] Jenin can now be allocated stat points from the Team interface.
[/p][/*][*][p] The Jenin Lodge now displays equipped gear comparison when viewing items. [/p][p][/p][/*][*][p] Changed "Release" to "Batch Refine"; refining Jenin now grants experience.[/p][/*][*][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p] Fixed an issue where upgrading a Jenin directly to Level 10 would prevent completion of the "Upgrade Jenin to Level 5" quest.
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed a bug where combat and gear crafting data from old saves persisted in new saves when switching archives.
[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: v1.0.14 Playtest Update
notes.content:
[h2]New / Optimizations[/h2][list][*][p] Added Jenin filtering function to the Jenin Lodge and Team interface.
[/p][/*][*][p] Added manual refresh function to the Shop and Jenin Merchant.
[/p][/*][*][p] Hunting time in the Hunting Lodge is now related to the quality and level of dispatched Jenin.
[/p][/*][*][p] Added an Abandon function for Time-Limited Quests.
[/p][/*][*][p] Infinity Tower cap in the Playtest version has been changed to 200 floors.
[/p][/*][/list][h2]Fixes / Adjustments[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where pressing ESC during initial Jenin selection would hide the interface, preventing selection.
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed a bug where talent icons overlapped during initial Jenin selection.
[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where clicking the "Complete" button was ineffective when finishing the Dreamy Meadow (Hell) quest.
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed inconsistent line breaks in quest descriptions.
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed incorrect stat bonuses in the Heavenly Thunder skill description.
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed an issue where Jenin equipment locks were not displayed correctly.
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed a bug in the Blacksmith where crafting scrolls incorrectly showed a requirement to clear 0 floors of the Infinity Tower[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p] Fixed a bug where time-limited quests incorrectly displayed the wrong scroll type.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 📢 Playtest Now Live! | Hatch & Raise Ultimate Jenin, Embark on Your Adventure!
notes.content:
Hello, brave Adventurers!

The gates of the dungeon have opened, are you ready to embark on a fantastic adventure? We warmly invite you to experience our Playtest version! 🎉 Your feedback is crucial for game optimization, and together, let's make Fantasy Idle Dungeon better and better!

[h2]🔮 Sneak Peek at Game Features[/h2]
In this Playtest, you'll get to experience:
 
 [list]
[*] [b] Hatch, Raise, and Train: [/b]Personally hatch and cultivate a wide variety of ultimate Jenin!
[*]  [b]Assemble an Unbeatable Adventure Team: [/b]Strategize and build the strongest legion to conquer the dungeon!
[*]  [b]Idle Combat: [/b]Even when you're offline, your adventure continues, and your Jenin grow steadily.
[*]  [b]Freely Customize Gear: [/b]Craft your exclusive adventure equipment to boost combat power and strategic depth.
[/list]
 
Every adventurer's feedback is our driving force. Found a problem/bug? Or have any suggestions regarding gameplay, Jenin development, or combat experience? Please let us know! We are eager to hear your thoughts!
We also welcome you to join our [url=https://discord.gg/sqGb8ey6DZ]Discord Channel[/url], to find like-minded players and share your tips for raising Jenin!

[h2]❤️  Add to Wishlist Now! And start your adventure in the dungeon![/h2]
